description: Post the initial status comment as the authenticated user when no existing claim is found. Format: <!-- otto:v1 status run=<run-uuid> machine=<machine-uuid> source=<comment-type>:<comment-id> --> followed by the [Otto] header and Status: running. After posting, re-fetch the thread one more time. If two Otto status comments now exist for this source, the one with the earlier created_at wins; the loser posts 'aborted (duplicate claim)' to its own comment and stops.
title: Status comment creation and duplicate claim self-abort
